credits_text: She came from the past to reclaim her lost love, but the past must die! Starring Terry O'Quinn, Kristy McNichol, Elisabeth Brooks, Blair Parker, James Mathers, Terry O'Quinn, Michael Spence, Kevin J. Hagen, Joseph Jahn, Jay B. Davis, Duffy 'Duff' Gabriel, Philip Boge. Produced by Wind River Productions.
